propositions: pure single-pass prepacked verification rejects valid criteria due to imperfect evidence packs, causing false-positive rejections
filter+fallback design prevents false-positive rejection by allowing filter to only PASS or ABSTAIN (never FAIL), then running existing agentic verifier on abstained criteria only

deterministic per-AC evidence packs (grep-at-ref, file_impact slices, referencing commits, test function listings) with 6KB/AC cap can PASS greppable artifact ACs but must ABSTAIN on runtime-outcome ACs

across 6 test cases (3 real closed tickets + 3 adversarial variants with planted-unmet ACs) filter+fallback achieved 0 false PASSes on adversarial variants while delivering -26% token cost vs pure-agentic control (-46% on real tickets only)

8000-character description admission cap in verify_completion deterministically rejects oversized tickets; adversarial edits must be length-neutral and productized reducer must re-check cap after AC-block reduction

coverage is bimodal by AC style (90% for test/symbol-citing ACs, 0% for runtime-outcome ACs) rather than by ticket size; filter cost is negligible (~0.4% of control agentic spend) making worst case cost-neutral-within-variance
